references.text: Preparation (Gen 46:31) and execution (Gen 47:1) of the same diplomatic strategy toward Pharaoh.
The message in Gen 47:1 explains the positive reaction described in Gen 45:16.
Pharaoh responds to the message in Gen 47:1 by inviting the family to settle (Gen 45:17).
Typological contrast: The livestock remain in Goshen (Gen 47:1) vs. the livestock remain during the exodus (Exod 10:24).
A summarizing reference confirming that the clan's arrival (Gen 47:1) made them known to Pharaoh.
Contrast between hidden identity (Gen 42:7) and revelation of origin (Gen 47:1).
